assumptions: Robust LP: finite complete competitor universe and simultaneous lower energy bounds; exact equivalence is for independent intervals.
Random audit: support plane and Q frozen before audit, alternatives have instability depth eta and Q bad-set mass at least rho, and query error is less than eta.
Minimax: finite known IDs, exact oracle, and one hidden candidate; no structural prior or lower bound for unqueried energies.
Model-to-nature transfer requires matched Gibbs-energy intervals and is not supplied by DFT calibration alone.
contract.interface: Target phase with normalized composition x_t and upper interval U_t; admitted competitor IDs z with compositions x_z and lower intervals L_z; optional frozen Q over omitted IDs; same per-atom thermodynamic state/fidelity.

costs.robust_global: Enumerate/construct valid lower bounds over every competitor; then solve hull LP and check primal/dual witness.
costs.audit: m=ceil(log(delta)/log(1-rho)) DFT query candidates; charge candidate generation, relaxation, static energies, higher-fidelity corrections, and core-hours.
costs.synthesis: If each relevant hit is detected with conditional probability p_min, m=ceil(log(delta)/log(1-rho*p_min)); charge all synthesis and characterization attempts.
costs.composition: q-element denominator-M grid has binom(M+q-1,q-1) points; multiply by structure-family count.

candidate.representation: LP of competitor lower energy bounds at the target composition; dual affine support plane. With omitted phases, frozen Q samples IDs and checks energy residuals below that plane.
candidate.hypothesis: A global deterministic certificate exists exactly when the complete finite lower-bound hull is above the target upper bound; a probabilistic alternative has false-stable risk <=(1-rho)^m only under a declared Q-mass/depth premise.
candidate.strongest_comparator: CAL for fixed-grid query allocation; GNoME as the large-scale candidate generation/DFT pipeline; uniform sampling and complete-universe lower-bound LP.
candidate.falsifier_or_next_experiment: Blindly hide a known A2B phase in a fully enumerated binary benchmark; compare all methods at equal DFT and candidate-generation cost; check the hull inequality and measured Q prevalence. Follow with matched-state calorimetry/diffraction if a nature-level claim is sought.

exact_missing_lemma: A defensible positive prevalence floor rho and depth eta for realistic unenumerated polymorphs, or a checkable energy lower-bound oracle covering all structures; plus model-to-nature Gibbs error and synthesis detection p_min.
comparator: CAL expected information gain and GNoME-style ranking/candidate generation under equal training/reference data, candidate universe, DFT calls, and charged compute; uniform random baseline.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: If a frozen coverage certificate labels global-stable and withheld A2B violates the same-state Gibbs/DFT hull by more than combined uncertainty, it is false. If a complete set has Q(B_eta)<rho, the discovery assumption fails.
